description: Copy and content builds: brief-confirmed, no-fabrication copy gated by a brief/tone check and an [F<n>]-tagged fact check instead of lint/typecheck/tests.

add.instructions: Write the copy per the plan and the confirmed brief (copywriting rules: brief confirmed before writing, no fabricated claims). Tag every claim [F<n>] against the facts file. Write production_artifacts/01_copy.md and the state.d fragment.

gates.brief-tone: The brief was confirmed before writing and the documented brand voice is honoured throughout
gates.fact-check: Every claim carries an [F<n>] tag that resolves to the facts file — no claim without a source (the pb-social-pack / pb-newsletter convention)

selection.description: Pick when the goal is written content: landing-page copy, newsletters, social posts, taglines.

notes: agentType godmode-ui-ux is the closest compiled agent (it owns landing pages); the domain behavior comes from the copywriting skill and the fact-check gate mirrors pb-social-pack step 4's [F<n>] claim tagging and pb-newsletter's every-claim-cites-a-source verify. Known persona gap: nodes need no MCP server (copy-only; fact sources come from the brief), which no persona file covers yet.
